findings.description: The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Although Amazon S3 now automatically applies SSE-S3 to new uploads, this configuration does not explicitly enforce or declare an encryption requirement; however, lack of an explicit bucket encryption block alone is not substantiated as a vulnerability under current S3 defaults.
